title: Recursive scalar substitution intertwines the canonical comparison
statement: Fix a prime ell, finite extensions E,L of Q_ell and an algebra homomorphism iota:E→L. Let Z→X→Y be composable scheme morphisms h,f with ell invertible at every point of all three schemes. Let M_i (i:Fin 3) be constructible derived-complete integral E objects on Y, P_i arbitrary flat-term K-flat representatives, and phi_i:Q(P_i)≅M_i. Use the exact strict quotient systems, expression evaluations, recursive substitutions, scalarBeta, scalarLeft, scalarRight and scalarSubstitution of [def-pur-completed-comparison-quotient-realization-data]. Fix good:GoodExpressions for the E quotient expressions. Write A_s=pullF(tensor(input 0,input 1)) and A_t=tensor(pullF(input 0),pullF(input 1)); write c_D for comparison at D and F_D for coefficientSequenceLimit at D. Fix any normalized L Roos model rhoY and normalized scalar model SY for the prescribed E reconstruction calculus at Y, as in [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models], and any goodL proving SystemGood for every strict expression on the scalarQuotients(P). Let beta_A=scalarBeta(M,P,phi,good,SY,goodL,A). Then beta_As ≫ F_L.map(Q.map(c_L(scalarQuotients(P)_0,scalarQuotients(P)_1).hom)) equals canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor(L,f,scalar(M_0),scalar(M_1)).hom.hom ≫ beta_At. The canonical comparison is exactly [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-integral-construction]. No invertibility of beta is assumed.

theorem completedScalarBetaComparison
    {Z X Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [∀ z : Z, Invertible (l : Z.residueField z)]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (M : Fin 3 → sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y)
    (P : Fin 3 → (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory)
    (φ : ∀ i : Fin 3, DerivedCategory.Q.obj (P i).obj ≅ (M i).obj)
    (good : GoodExpressions l E h f P)
    {ρY : IntegralComparisonRoosModel l L Y}
    (SY : IntegralComparisonScalarModel l E L ι Y (pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y) ρY)
    (goodL : ∀ {W : Scheme.{u}} (A : StrictQuotient.Expression h f 3 W),
      StrictQuotient.SystemGood l L (strictValue l L (scalarQuotients l E L ι P) A)) :
    scalarBeta l E L ι M P φ good SY goodL (sourceExpression h f) ≫
      (coefficientSequenceLimit l L X).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map
        (comparison l L f ((scalarQuotients l E L ι P) 0)
          ((scalarQuotients l E L ι P) 1)).hom) =
    (canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor l L f
      ((sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension 0 l
        (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (Fact.out : l.Prime)) E L ι Y).obj (M 0))
      ((sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension 0 l
        (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (Fact.out : l.Prime)) E L ι Y).obj (M 1))).hom.hom ≫
      scalarBeta l E L ι M P φ good SY goodL (targetExpression h f)
